sections.name: Hero
text:
AI can copy anyone’s face.
Permission is what’s scarce.
Semblanse is the permission layer for AI ads with real creators. Brands license a creator’s likeness for one campaign at a time, and the creator approves every final ad.

sections.name: Beliefs
text:
A creator is
more than a face.
A creator’s stories, tone and limits are what audiences trust, not just their face.
One brand, one campaign, a set term and an end date.
Creators should be paid for judgment.
Not just for the hours they spend filming.

sections.name: What we don’t do
text: Brands produce the ads in their own tools. We handle the permission.
We don’t sell generic AI actors.
Every ad stars a real, verified creator who said yes.
We don’t hand out training rights.
A campaign licence never includes permission to train AI on a creator’s samples.

sections.name: Document
text: We only collect what we need to run the waitlist and the pilots.
Your samples go only to the brand that licenses you, for that campaign.
No licence ever includes permission to train AI on your likeness.
You can ask us to delete it at any time.
Semblanse runs this website and our pilot campaigns. For any privacy question or request, write to us through the contact page.
Waitlist applications: your name, email, what you make, where you live, the profiles you link, and anything you tell us you won’t promote.
Instagram sign-in: your username and basic profile details, so we can confirm the account is yours. We can’t post for you or read your messages.
Pilot requests and messages: your name, work email, company and what you tell us.
Pilot creators: the face, body and voice samples you record, the stories and limits you share, and a record of every approval.
To run the waitlist and match you with campaigns, confirm identities, prepare and track campaign licences, pay creators, reply to you, and improve the service.

No brand can use your likeness until you accept its offer. Your samples go only to the brand that licenses you, for that campaign. A licence never includes permission to train AI on your samples, and when it ends, the brand must stop running the ads.
The brand in a licence you’ve accepted, only for that campaign.
Service providers who host, email and process payments for us, under contracts that limit how they use it.
Authorities, if the law requires it.

Waitlist details stay until you ask us to remove them. Campaign records stay for the length of the licence, and afterwards for as long as payment and legal records require. How long we keep samples after a licence ends is still being set.
You can ask to see, correct or delete your information, or leave the waitlist, at any time through the contact page. Where we rely on your consent, you can withdraw it.
If we change this policy, we’ll update the date at the top and email waitlist members about anything important.

sections.name: Header
text: The rules for using this website and joining the waitlist. Each campaign also has its own licence, agreed by the creator and the brand before anything starts.

sections.name: Document
text: Joining the waitlist is free and grants no rights to your likeness.
Apply only as yourself, and you must be 18 or older.
Every campaign is covered by its own licence, which wins for that campaign.
Brands may only run the versions a creator has approved.
You can browse and use this site for your own information. Please don’t misuse it, try to break it, or scrape it.
Joining the waitlist doesn’t guarantee a campaign, and it grants no rights to your likeness. We may contact you about campaigns that fit what you make.
You must be 18 or older and apply only as yourself. Don’t submit someone else’s face, voice or account.
Each campaign has its own licence. It sets the brand, fee, channels, territory, term and creative limits. If a licence and these terms differ, the licence applies to that campaign.
Use a creator’s likeness only as their licence allows, and only run versions the creator has approved. Licences set out the penalties for use outside their terms.
You keep ownership of what you share with us, and you let us use it to run the waitlist and set up campaigns. The Semblanse name, site and materials belong to us.
The site is provided as it is. To the extent the law allows, we aren’t responsible for indirect losses from using it.
The laws that apply to these terms, and where disputes are resolved, are still being set.
We may update these terms, and the date at the top shows the latest version. Questions? Write to us through the contact page.
